review_candidates.title: Microsoft Azure & M365 Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: In this role, you will administer, secure, and optimize Azure and Microsoft 365 services while improving reliability, user experience, and operational efficiency across the organization. Duties And Responsibilities Design, deploy, configure, and maintain Microsoft Azure infrastructure across approved subscriptions, resource groups, regions, and landing-zone patterns. Administer Azure Virtual Machines, managed disks, Storage Accounts, Virtual Networks, Network Security Groups, private endpoints,
eligibility_evidence: We are looking for a skilled cloud infrastructure professional with experience in Azure, Microsoft 365, identity management, and hybrid environments.
Administer Azure Virtual Machines, managed disks, Storage Accounts, Virtual Networks, Network Security Groups, private endpoints, load-balancing services, DNS, backup, and hybrid connectivity.
Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, mail flow, federation, permissions, sharing, and hybrid connectivity concepts.
Experience supporting hybrid identity, Exchange hybrid, Azure-connected infrastructure, VPN, ExpressRoute, or enterprise network integrations.
